decisions.reason: The Trivital supplement range is a visible, branded line that the firm presented prominently on its own pages, so management is inclined to keep supporting it despite uncertain results.
The skin and hair supplement was publicly launched as part of the Trivital range, and its modest pharmacy-channel investment makes it easier to keep it in place than to admit failure.
The joint health supplement was announced as new and moved to a page of its own in 2019, which signals growing commitment that management will want to justify.
The immune supplement was promoted in a press release as the newest Trivital product, and immune products gained relevance after 2020, so weak results can be read as temporary.
The 2018 valsartan contamination problem can be blamed on an external supplier rather than the product decision, and keeping a generic antihypertensive fits the core pharma business.
The OTC migraine triptan sits at the center of the firm's established migraine and pain expertise, so the firm is strongly committed to it.
